title: Rating Rule — Adjusted Release Clearance Charge by Coverage Package (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Rule

On the release of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing, the adjusted release clearance charge follows the endorsement fee of the certified policy's coverage package — the per-endorsement fee set for the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package the certified policy is written on:

| Package endorsement fee | Adjusted release clearance charge |
|---|---|
| Zero | Half the release clearance charge, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| More than zero and no more than 10.00 | Three quarters of the release clearance charge, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| More than 10.00 | The release clearance charge as it stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical clearance amounts)

| Release clearance charge | Endorsement fee zero | Endorsement fee above zero up to 10.00 | Endorsement fee above 10.00 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12.00 | 6.00 | 9.00 | 12.00 |
| 8.00 | 4.00 | 6.00 | 8.00 |
| 7.00 | 3.00 (half is 3.50, rounded down) | 6.00 (three quarters is 5.25, rounded up) | 7.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Boundary

An endorsement fee of exactly 10.00 falls in the middle line (three quarters, rounded up). An endorsement fee of 10.01 or more falls in the last line. Only a fee of exactly zero falls in the first line.
